package.name: dual_arm_transport
package.description:
C4.3 S2: dual-end grasp starting configuration and the transport baseline.
Scope (正式执行规划 §6 S2): freeze the object + grasp geometry, enumerate ALL hard-passing analytic IK branches per arm (never "one solution per arm"), screen the left x right CARTESIAN PRODUCT, validate the full geometry collision in explicit scopes, check pre-grasp path reachability, and freeze an INDEPENDENT transport_baseline.yaml with explicit failure attribution.
The math primitives (GraspGeometry / anchoredObjectPose / closureResidual) live in dual_arm_kinematics (C4.3 S1) and are reused, never re-derived here. The IK layer / offline scene / scope-aware collision backend are reused from dual_arm_pose_optimization through its PUBLIC exported interface (see C4.3_S2_实施方案.md §10.2) -- no private relative-path includes, no copied IK.
Frame discipline (user m02331 D2): grasp regions, contact faces and approach directions are defined in the OBJECT LOCAL frame and must be invariant under any rigid transform of the object.
